_comment: Hand-maintained status notes merged by gen_feature_matrix.py. 'status' here can only LOWER a command's status (Partial/Blocked/Not started) or add notes; 'Verified' always comes from test results.

IDM_FILE_OPEN_CMD.mac: Opens Terminal.app at the file's folder

IDM_FILE_OPEN_POWERSHELL.mac: Opens pwsh (PowerShell for macOS) in Terminal at the file's folder; disabled when pwsh is not installed
IDM_FILE_OPEN_POWERSHELL.diff: Needs PowerShell for macOS (for example brew install powershell)

IDM_FILE_CONTAININGFOLDERASWORKSPACE.mac: Adds the folder to Folder as Workspace (FSEvents keep it current)

IDM_FILE_OPENFOLDERASWORKSPACE.mac: Folder chooser, then Folder as Workspace

IDM_FILE_DELETE.mac: Moves the file to the macOS Trash

IDM_FILE_RENAME.mac: Untitled: renames the tab; file: moves the file via a save panel

IDM_FILE_PRINT.mac: macOS print system; Preferences > Print: colour mode, line numbers, margins, header/footer variables, form feed as page break

IDM_FILE_PRINTNOW.mac: Prints with the same settings without the print dialog

IDM_FILE_EXIT.mac: Also Quit Textpad++ (⌘Q) in the application menu

IDM_EDIT_AUTOCOMPLETE.mac: Function completion from the upstream API files (autoCompletion/<language>.xml, 34 bundled); user API files in the settings folder take precedence

IDM_EDIT_AUTOCOMPLETE_PATH.mac: Completes absolute paths (/… and ~/…), the macOS equivalent of upstream's C:\… paths

IDM_EDIT_FUNCCALLTIP.mac: Function parameter hint from the API files; current parameter highlighted, overloads shown as 1 of N

IDM_EDIT_FUNCCALLTIP_PREVIOUS.mac: Previous overload of the hint shown

IDM_EDIT_FUNCCALLTIP_NEXT.mac: Next overload of the hint shown

IDM_EDIT_CHANGESEARCHENGINE.mac: Opens Preferences > Search Engine (DuckDuckGo, Google, Yahoo!, Stack Overflow or a custom URL with $(CURRENT_WORD))

IDM_EDIT_CHAR_PANEL.mac: Code page of the document (or the ANSI code page); double-click inserts the character or the HTML entity

IDM_EDIT_CLIPBOARDHISTORY_PANEL.mac: macOS has no clipboard-change event: the clipboard is checked every 0.5 s

IDM_EDIT_COLUMNMODE.mac: Column Editor dialog (text or numbers, dec/hex/oct/bin, leading zeros/spaces)

IDM_EDIT_PASTE_AS_HTML.mac: Pastes the raw HTML markup from the pasteboard (public.html)

IDM_EDIT_PASTE_AS_RTF.mac: Pastes the raw RTF markup from the pasteboard (public.rtf)

IDM_SEARCH_FINDINCREMENT.mac: Bar above the status bar (or below the toolbar)

IDM_SEARCH_FINDCHARINRANGE.mac: Non-modal dialog with upstream's ranges, Up/Down and Wrap around
IDM_SEARCH_FINDCHARINRANGE.diff: Selects the whole character (upstream selects one byte of a multi-byte UTF-8 character)

IDM_VIEW_POSTIT.mac: Hides toolbar, tabs, status bar and the window title bar (drag the window by its background)
IDM_VIEW_POSTIT.diff: The macOS menu bar is global and stays visible

IDM_VIEW_DISTRACTIONFREE.mac: Full screen, chrome hidden, side padding = view width / N (Preferences, N = 3–9, upstream default 4)

IDM_VIEW_IN_IE.diff: Internet Explorer does not exist on macOS; mapped to Safari

IDM_VIEW_HIDELINES.mac: Upstream hide-lines markers: adjacent sections merge, a click on a marker shows the lines, sections survive document switches

IDM_VIEW_GOTO_NEW_INSTANCE.mac: Starts a second Textpad++ (-multiInst -nosession <file>) and closes the document here

IDM_VIEW_LOAD_IN_NEW_INSTANCE.mac: Starts a second Textpad++ with the file (-multiInst -nosession <file>)

IDM_VIEW_DOC_MAP.mac: Shares the document; zoom -10, proportional scrolling, click/drag scrolls the editor

IDM_EDIT_RTL.diff: Scintilla's bidirectional (RTL) mode is only implemented for Win32 DirectWrite

IDM_FORMAT_ANSI.diff: "ANSI" = Windows-1252 by default (configurable), because macOS has no system ANSI code page

IDM_FORMAT_CONV2_ANSI.diff: Unrepresentable characters are reported with a warning at save time instead of being replaced immediately

IDM_FORMAT_DOS_720.mac: Built-in table (macOS iconv has no CP720), generated from Windows' code page data

IDM_LANG_USER_DLG.mac: Opens the User Defined Language panel (upstream 2.1 XML; four tabs, Styler dialogs, import/export)
IDM_LANG_USER_DLG.diff: Docked mode not available; panel floats

IDM_LANG_USER.mac: Applies the UDL selected in the panel (or the first one) to the current document

IDM_SETTING_PREFERENCE.mac: Opens Preferences with all 24 upstream pages
IDM_SETTING_PREFERENCE.diff: Options that cannot work on macOS or depend on unbuilt features are shown disabled with the reason (see KNOWN_DIFFERENCES)

IDM_LANGSTYLE_CONFIG_DLG.mac: Upstream Style Configurator: theme, language, style, colours, font, user ext., user-defined keywords, Global override, Go to settings; Save & Close writes stylers.xml / themes/<name>.xml
IDM_LANGSTYLE_CONFIG_DLG.diff: No Transparency option (a Windows-only window feature)

IDM_SETTING_SHORTCUT_MAPPER.mac: Main menu / Macros / Run commands / Plugin commands / Scintilla commands; Modify, Clear, Delete, filter, conflict report; saved to shortcuts.xml (upstream format)
IDM_SETTING_SHORTCUT_MAPPER.diff: Plugin commands tab is empty (no plugin host); a 'Control' key flag is added for the macOS scheme

IDM_SETTING_IMPORTPLUGIN.mac: Imports native .tpplugin bundles (docs/PLUGINS.md) and loads them at once
IDM_SETTING_IMPORTPLUGIN.diff: Windows DLL plugins cannot run on macOS; Notepad++ asks for a restart, Textpad++ only when the plugin is already running

IDM_SETTING_EDITCONTEXTMENU.mac: Opens the user's contextMenu.xml (copied from the default first); changes apply when the menu next opens

IDM_SETTING_OPENPLUGINSDIR.diff: Opens the plugins folder; plugins are not loaded yet

IDM_EXECUTE.mac: Runs through /bin/sh with shell-quoted $(…) variables; URLs open in the browser; saved commands appear in the Run menu with their shortcuts

IDM_MACRO_SAVECURRENTMACRO.mac: Name + shortcut (upstream Shortcut dialog); the macro appears in the Macro menu with its shortcut

IDM_UPDATE_NPP.mac: Reads a GUP XML feed whose address is built in with make dmg UPDATE_URL=…; downloads the app zip, checks SHA-256 + ECDSA signature, replaces the app in place and relaunches (or at quit); DMG fallback
IDM_UPDATE_NPP.diff: Signed in-place update instead of an installer. A build without UPDATE_URL says it has no update address

IDM_CONFUPDATERPROXY.mac: HTTP/HTTPS proxy server and port for the updater

IDM_HOMESWEETHOME.diff: Opened the upstream project's web site; removed so the upstream name appears nowhere (by request)

IDM_PROJECTPAGE.diff: Opened the upstream project's web site; removed so the upstream name appears nowhere (by request)

IDM_ONLINEDOCUMENT.diff: Opened the upstream project's web site; removed so the upstream name appears nowhere (by request)

IDM_FORUM.diff: Opened the upstream project's web site; removed so the upstream name appears nowhere (by request)

IDM_CMDLINEARGUMENTS.mac: Shows the upstream option list; all options are parsed at launch and forwarded to a running Textpad++ in mono-instance mode
IDM_CMDLINEARGUMENTS.diff: -qn easter-egg quotes are not included; -L is accepted (English only); -systemtray starts hidden (no system tray on macOS); -openFoldersAsWorkspace adds the folders to Folder as Workspace

IDM_WINDOW_MRU_FIRST.mac: IDM_WINDOW_MRU_FIRST + i activate the current view's documents ("1: path", "*" when modified)

IDM_EDIT_AUTOCOMPLETE_CURRENTFILE.mac: Word completion; a single match is inserted directly (upstream)

IDM_SETTING_SHORTCUT_MAPPER_MACRO.mac: Opens the Shortcut Mapper on the Macros tab

IDM_SETTING_SHORTCUT_MAPPER_RUN.mac: Opens the Shortcut Mapper on the Run commands tab

IDM_LANG_UDLCOLLECTION_PROJECT_SITE.diff: Opened the upstream project's web site; removed so the upstream name appears nowhere (by request)

features: Toolbar (Standard icons: small, upstream button order)
Colourful (default, small/large), Standard, Fluent small/large (regular or filled) with Fluent colorization
Document tab bar: icons for saved/unsaved/read-only/monitoring, close button, orange active indicator
Middle-click closes a tab; double-click empty area creates a new document
Pin / unpin tabs (pinned tabs move first)
Tab context menu (close variants, save, reveal, rename, trash, reload, print, read-only, copy paths, move/clone, colours, pin)
Vertical: the bar on the left edge with rotated labels; multi-line: rows wrap
Drag a tab to the other view
Onto the other view moves (⌥ clones; Ctrl upstream); out of the window opens a new instance
Doc type | length/lines | Ln/Col/Pos/Sel | EOL | encoding | INS/OVR
Line numbers (dynamic width), bookmark margin (click to toggle), box-tree fold margin, change-history margin
Port of upstream XmlMatchedTagsHighlighter (pairs, attributes, self-closing)
Built from contextMenu.xml (upstream default or the user copy); Settings > Edit Popup ContextMenu
Side by side or stacked (right-click the splitter: Rotate to right / left)
Search results panel (searchResult lexer, folding, double-click navigation, F4/Shift+F4)
Docked at the bottom or floating (header menu)
Optional (Preferences > General > Menu); the macOS menu bar keeps the same menus; ＋ ▼ ✕ shortcuts; Hide toggled by ⌥ or F10
Follow macOS / Light / Dark; upstream tones (Black … Olive) and Customized colours
Encoding detection: BOM (UTF-8/16LE/16BE), valid UTF-8, ANSI fallback
BOM, then uchardet (as bundled by Notepad++), then UTF-8 / ANSI
Byte-exact round trip for unmodified content (incl. invalid bytes, NUL, mixed EOL)
Atomic save (temp file + fsync + rename) preserving permissions/ACL/xattrs and symlinks
External change detection (reload prompt), deleted-file handling
Open from command line / Finder Open With / Dock drop (CFBundleDocumentTypes)
Drag and drop files onto the editor window
Files open; folders become Folder as Workspace roots (or their files open, per Preferences)
Files from 32 MB load in the background (progress, Cancel); 3.2 GB log: open 14 s, find 4 s, save 4 s; growing logs append only new lines
Remember current session (session.xml, upstream layout + tp* attributes)
Session snapshot + periodic backup of unsaved buffers (default every 7 s)
A real child process is killed with SIGKILL and the next launch restores unsaved text and edits
General (localization, toolbar/tab/status bar visibility, menu options)
In-window menu bar (Hide, right shortcuts, F10 menu mode), 96 interface languages for menus and commands, custom dialog font
Icon sets and Fluent colorization switch live
Caret, current line, multi-editing, scrolling options
Right-click keeps selection option; touchpad option n/a
Non-printing characters, line wrap mode options
Column selection to multi-editing; C0 input prevention
Line number, fold style, edge, change-history display
Default EOL and encoding for new documents
Used by open/save panels; no automated test (needs modal panels)
Sets Textpad++ as the macOS default app per extension via NSWorkspace; untested because it changes system settings
Language menu compaction, tab settings per language
Hidden languages, compact menu and per-language tab settings
Tag match options; "Highlight comment/php/asp zone" is stored but unused upstream too
Applied by the Find dialog; covered indirectly by search tests
Mono-instance forwards arguments to the running Textpad++; multi-instance and session-in-new-instance start a second process
Settings in cloud folder, clickable links
Cloud folder holds preferences.plist, shortcuts.xml, themes, UDLs and API files; session and backups stay local; applies after a restart (as upstream)
DuckDuckGo / Google / Yahoo! / Stack Overflow / custom URL
Document Peeker, menu bar extra (system tray), encoding detection, auto-updater; rendering mode n/a
macOS-native plugin API, discovery, enable/disable, Plugins Admin
Native .tpplugin bundles with the Windows entry points and message numbers (UTF-8); docking panels and toolbar icons; Plugins Admin with an online list
User Defined Languages: XML import/export, editor dialog
Upstream 2.1 XML; preinstalled Markdown UDLs; the dialog floats or docks (Dock / Undock)
Import style themes (copy XML into the themes folder)
Upstream functionList parser rules, sort, filter, caret tracking
Live highlighting of 'Find what' matches while the dialog is open
Editor: Scintilla Cocoa accessibility; tab bar = tab group with Select/Close actions, labelled toolbar buttons, status bar texts
Upstream default shortcuts on menu items (macOS scheme: Ctrl -> Command, reserved combos on Control)
macOS scheme: Scintilla Cocoa native keys; Windows scheme: upstream scintKeyDefs; both editable in the Shortcut Mapper
Document Peeker: peek on tab (floating view) / on the Document Map
Docking panels left and right (Document List, Map, Function List, Folder as Workspace, Projects, Character Panel, Clipboard History)
Docked left, right, top or bottom, or floating (each panel header has a dock menu)
Menu bar extra for Minimize / Close to system tray, with the upstream tray menu
Over-the-air updates: GUP XML feed, signed zip (SHA-256 + ECDSA P-256), in-place replace and relaunch, install at quit, proxy, auto-check every 15 days
Interface languages (upstream nativeLang files): menus, sub-menus, command labels
In-window menu bar keyboard access: F10 menu mode, arrows, mnemonic letters, Esc
⌥ + letter is not used: on macOS it types accented characters
No upstream product name anywhere in the application (menus, dialogs, data files, binary)
Copyright notices of the original authors are kept, as the GPL requires
Plugins Admin online list: download, SHA-256 check, install, updates
The list address comes with UPDATE_URL at build time
JSON Tools (built in): Format, Compress, Validate with line/column errors, Sort Keys, Escape/Unescape string, JSON to CSV, Decode JWT
Upstream needs a plugin for this
Toolbar tooltips: name, shortcut and a one-line description of each button
XML Tools (built in): Pretty Print, Compress, well-formedness check with line/column, XPath Query
Encode - Decode (built in): Base64, URL, HTML entities, Unicode \uXXXX, hex bytes
Upstream ships MIME Tools / Converter plugins for part of this
Text Tools (built in): camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE, kebab-case, dot.case, Align on = / :, Sort Lines by Length, Escape for Regex
Convert (built in): CSV to JSON, CSV to Markdown table, JSON to CSV, Unix time <-> date, decimal <-> hex
Insert (built in): UUID, Unix timestamp, ISO 8601 date-time, Lorem ipsum, random password
Long pop-up texts scroll in a fixed-size box that fits a 13-inch screen; the command audit flags any window taller than 820 pt
Escape closes pop-ups and dialogs (Cancel / Close / OK / the only button; tool windows); the editor keeps its own Escape
Markdown Live Preview beside the text, editable in place (edits written back as Markdown), task boxes, links, scroll sync; HTML page preview; asked when a .md file opens
Markdown rendering is Textpad++'s own (CommonMark subset + GFM tables, task lists, strikethrough)
View > Compare: side by side, changed / added / deleted lines and changed characters marked, aligned with blank space, synchronized scrolling, next / previous difference, live re-compare
Command Palette (⇧⌘A): every menu command, plugin, macro and Run command by name, with path and shortcut
Modern Look: rounded tabs, title bar in the toolbar colour, hover highlights, macOS Light / Dark themes
View > Modern Look turns it off
Git change markers in the margin (added / changed / deleted since the last commit), next / previous change
Needs git from Homebrew, the Command Line Tools or Xcode
CSV Rainbow Columns (visible lines only, fast on big files); Align / Shrink Columns
Code Formatter: Format Document by language, Format SQL / HTML / CSS, Minify CSS
Snippets: trigger + Tab, fields with Tab / ⇧Tab, built-in sets for 15 languages, user snippets.json
Dialogs translated with the interface language (strings matched through english.xml)
Only strings that exist in the language files; Textpad++'s own new dialogs stay English
Textpad++ Features page: Markdown opening, look, snippets, Git markers, CSV colours, Compare spaces
gaps: Windows code cannot run on macOS; native .tpplugin plugins instead
On macOS ⌥ + letter types accented characters; F10 menu mode and the mnemonic letters work instead
Scintilla on macOS has one renderer (Core Graphics)
A Windows touchpad driver workaround; macOS scrolling has no such issue
